name: Mahou Kishi Lynfolia
original_name: 魔法騎士リーンフォリア
source:
Kamiyama Haruka is a beloved girlfriend of protagonist Ichijou Mamoru as well as Magie Ritter Lynfolia — one of the magical knights fighting monsters and demonic beings. Bound by an unbreakable bond as battle partners, the two suffer a brutal defeat against a powerful demon lord, and Mamoru is captured as a prisoner of war.

Left behind, Haruka forms a temporary partnership with her comrade Yahagi Yajuurou to rescue her lover. But to unleash her full power as a Magie Ritter, she must resolve the "reactive lust" — a physical craving that follows combat. After much internal struggle and resistance, Haruka reluctantly gives in and gets physical with Yajuurou. There, she discovers a profound pleasure she never knew existed.

When they finally succeed in rescuing Mamoru, she realizes the terrible truth: her body has changed... and now only sex with Yajuurou can satisfy her.

[Translated from the [url=https://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/magie_r/]official site[/url]]
translation:
神山遥是主角一条守以及与怪物和恶魔战斗的魔法骑士之一玛吉·里特·琳芙莉亚的挚爱女友。两人作为战斗伙伴有着牢不可破的纽带，但在强大的恶魔领主面前惨遭失败，卫被俘虏为战俘。

遥被留下，与她的战友矢萩弥十郎结成临时伙伴，以营救她的爱人。但为了充分发挥玛吉·里特的力量，她必须解决“反应性欲望”——战斗后产生的身体渴望。经过一番内心挣扎和抵抗后，遥不情愿地屈服并与矢十郎发生了肢体冲突。在那里，她发现了一种她从未意识到的深刻快乐。

当他们最终成功营救阿卫时，她意识到了一个可怕的事实：她的身体已经发生了变化……现在只有与矢十郎发生性关系才能满足她。

[翻译自[url=https://lusterise.nexton-net.jp/product/magie_r/]官方网站[/url]]
